title: Syscall GetNextProcess fallback topology
contracts: Syscall_GetNextProcess owns the fallback process-handle filtering loop only when Obj_CallbackInstalled is false
When Obj_CallbackInstalled is true the native syscall path is allowed because process handle access is filtered by object callbacks
The fallback loop redirects the output handle through the temporary TLS handle slot before native dispatch
Rejected outside-box process handles are closed before the next enumeration attempt
Accepted process handles are returned through Syscall_WriteRestoredHandleToUser
No public Microsoft Learn NtGetNextProcess DDI page was found so the syscall ABI remains a Windows runtime gate
This SREV changes comments and proof only
local_edges: GetNextProcess output handle -> Syscall_ReplaceTargetHandle -> TLS slot
denied NewHandle -> user_args[0] -> next enumeration attempt
runtime_gate: Windows NtGetNextProcess matrix for ObCallbacks on off denied outside-box writable handles accepted same-box handles end-of-enumeration invalid output pointer and handle leaks
